children: Sweden chemical identification firm's Q3 net sales more than doubled yr/yr
Company reported positive EBITDA and EBIT after losses a year ago
Serstech expects a strong Q4 order intake, supporting growth and profitability in 2027
Company anticipates reducing sales and R&D fixed costs in 2027 versus 2026
Serstech sees minor production disruptions due to component shortages, but no major impact expected
IN-HOUSE PRODUCTION - Co doubled in-house production capacity during qtr, supporting gross margin improvement
COMPONENT INVENTORY - Co built up inventory ahead of electronic component shortages, enabling sales and deliveries but weakening cash position
RECORD ORDER INTAKE - Qtr order intake was second highest in co's history, with September shipments at record levels
Wall Street's median 12-month price target for Serstech AB is SEK0.80, about 63.9% above its November 2 closing price of SEK0.49
